close_pull-request: "close PR 2 in coilyco/api without merging?" "close stale PR 9 in coilysiren/site" "close PR 14 in coilyco/backend?" Closes the PR without merging it. See reopen_pull-request to reopen a closed unmerged PR.
create_organization-repository: 'Create a repo called coilyco/backend.' 'Make a private repo called migrations under coilyco.' 'Add a new repository named docs to my org.' Returns the created repository record. For listing existing org repos use list_organization-repository.
create_pull-request: "open a PR from feat/login into main in coilyco/api?" "create a PR in coilysiren/site from fix/typo to main" "open a PR from improve-search into dev in coilyco/backend?" Creates the PR from head branch into base branch with title and body. See edit_pull-request to change title, body, or base later.
create_release: "Create release v1.0.0 on main in coilyco/app?" "Draft a release named Nightly tagged v2.0 in coilysiren/tool?" "Publish a prerelease v0.9 on main in coilyco/website?" Creates a release with tag_name, target commitish, name, notes body, draft and prerelease flags. Use get_repository-release to view it.
dispatch_workflow: "Run release.yml on main in coilyco/app?" "Trigger deploy.yml on v1.2.0 in coilysiren/tool?" "Manually start publish.yml on main in coilyco/website?" It triggers the workflow_dispatch workflow by file name on the ref. Use list_action-run to see the resulting run.
edit_pull-request: "change title of PR 12 in coilyco/api?" "update body of PR 4 in coilysiren/site" "change base branch of PR 8 in coilyco/backend to dev?" Changes only the PR's title, body, or base branch. It cannot add reviewers, labels, or assignees. See close_pull-request to close it without merging.
edit_release: "Edit release 42 in coilyco/app to change its notes?" "Mark release 123 in coilysiren/tool as draft?" "Update prerelease flag on release 77 in coilyco/website?" Edits an existing release by numeric id with name, notes body, draft, and prerelease. Use get_repository-release to view current values.
edit_repository: "Can you change the description of coilyco/website?" "How do I set dev as the default branch in coilysiren/backend?" "Can you disable PRs on coilyco/mobile?" It changes only a repo description, website, default branch, has_issues, or has_pull_requests. Use get_repository to read current repo metadata first.
get_action-run: "What happened in Actions run 123456 in coilyco/app?" "Show run 987654 in coilyco/website?" "What is the conclusion of run 555 in coilysiren/tool?" Returns workflow, status, conclusion, commit, and timing for one run by run_id. Use list_action-run-job for jobs.
get_commit-status: "Is commit 3f2a1c green in coilyco/app?" "What is the overall CI state on main in coilyco/website?" "Did checks pass on v1.2.0 in coilysiren/tool?" Returns the combined overall CI state plus its statuses. Use list_commit-status for individual entries.
get_organization: 'What is the coilyco org profile?' 'Show me coilyco's description and website.' 'Is the coilyco org public?' Returns that org's full name, description, website, and visibility. For the people in it use list_organization-member.
get_pull-request: "what is PR 4 in coilyco/api?" "show PR 12 in coilysiren/site" "is PR 7 in coilyco/backend mergeable?" Returns title, body, state, mergeable, head and base branches, author, and merged status. See get_pull-request-file for the files it changes.
get_pull-request-commit: "what commits are in PR 3 in coilyco/api?" "show commits for PR 7 in coilysiren/site" "list commit history of PR 10 in coilyco/backend?" Returns the commits inside that PR, paged. See get_pull-request-file for the files changed in that PR.
get_pull-request-file: "what files changed in PR 2 in coilyco/api?" "show changed files and line counts for PR 8 in coilysiren/site" "which files are in PR 5 in coilyco/backend?" Returns each file with additions and deletions per file, paged. See get_pull-request-commit for the commits in that PR.
get_repository: "What is coilyco/website about?" "Are PRs enabled in coilysiren/backend?" "What is the default branch of coilyco/mobile?" It returns repo metadata including description, default branch, visibility, size, topics, stars, and issue, wiki, and PR flags. Use edit_repository to change description or feature flags.
get_repository-branch: "Does coilyco/website have a main branch?" "What is the head commit of dev in coilysiren/backend?" "Is the release branch protected in coilyco/mobile?" It returns one branch by name with its head commit and protection flag. Use list_repository-branch for all branches of the repo.
get_repository-content: "What is in README.md in coilyco/website?" "What content is in src/config.json in coilysiren/backend?" "What files are in the docs directory of coilyco/mobile?" It returns one file content as base64 at a path and optional ref, or entries of a directory path. Use list_repository-content for top level files and folders.
get_repository-release: "Show release v1.0.0 in coilyco/app?" "What assets are on release v2.0 in coilysiren/tool?" "Is release v3.0 in coilyco/website a draft?" Returns one release by tag name with name, notes, assets, draft and prerelease flags. Use list_repository-release to browse releases.
list_action-run: "Show recent Actions runs in coilyco/app?" "Which workflow runs failed on main in coilyco/website?" "List push runs in coilysiren/tool?" Returns Forgejo Actions workflow runs for a repo, filterable by event and status, newest first. Use get_action-run for one run by id.
list_action-run-job: "What jobs are in run 123456 in coilyco/app?" "Which jobs failed in run 987654 in coilyco/website?" "Show jobs for run 555 in coilysiren/tool?" Returns the jobs inside one Actions run with their status and no logs. Use get_action-run for run details.
list_commit-status: "What statuses are on commit 3f2a1c in coilyco/app?" "Which CI checks ran on main in coilyco/website?" "What posted on v1.2.0 in coilysiren/tool?" Returns each individual CI status entry with context, state, and description. Use get_commit-status for the overall CI state.
list_current-user-organization: 'What orgs is the bot in?' 'Which organizations does the bot belong to?' 'List my org memberships.' Returns organizations the server bot account belongs to. For a named user's org memberships use list_user-organization.
list_organization: 'What orgs are on this server?' 'List all organizations.' 'Show me every organization.' Returns every organization on the server. For orgs the bot belongs to use list_current-user-organization.
list_organization-member: 'Who is in the coilyco org?' 'List members of the coilyco org.' 'Show me everyone in that org.' Returns the members of one organization. For the org's profile details use get_organization.
list_organization-repository: 'What repos does coilyco have?' 'Show me coilyco's repositories.' 'List all repos under the coilyco org.' Returns repos owned by that one org. For repos owned by a user account use list_user-repository.
list_pull-request: "what are the open PRs in coilyco/api?" "what PRs did coilysiren post in coilyco/backend?" "list closed PRs in coilysiren/site?" Returns matching PRs with number, title, state, head and base. See get_pull-request for one PR's details.
list_repository: 'What repos can you see?' 'Show me every repo the bot can access.' 'List all accessible repos ordered by updated.' Returns repos the bot account can see across all owners, ordered as requested. For name searches use search_repository.
list_repository-branch: "What branches are in coilyco/website?" "Show branches in coilysiren/backend." "List branch heads for coilyco/mobile." It returns branch names with their head commits. For one branch by name use get_repository-branch.
list_repository-commit: "Show recent commits in coilyco/website." "List commits on main in coilysiren/backend." "What commits touched src/main.go in coilyco/mobile?" It returns commit history with optional branch or SHA, file path, stats, and changed files. Use list_repository-tree to find file paths by name or extension.
list_repository-content: "What files are in coilyco/website?" "Show top level folders in coilysiren/backend at main." "List the root contents of coilyco/mobile." It returns top level files and folders at a ref. Use get_repository-content for one file or directory by path.
list_repository-label: "What labels are defined on coilyco/website?" "Show PR labels in coilysiren/backend." "What issue labels exist in coilyco/mobile?" It returns the issue and PR labels defined on a repo. Use get_repository to see whether issues and PRs are enabled.
list_repository-release: "What releases are in coilyco/app?" "Show draft releases in coilysiren/tool?" "Find the release named v2.0 in coilyco/website?" Returns releases of a repo newest first, filterable by draft, prerelease, or a name query. Use get_repository-release for one release by tag.
list_repository-tag: "What tags exist in coilyco/app?" "Show tags with commits in coilysiren/tool?" "What commit is tag v1.0.0 in coilyco/website?" Returns git tags of a repo with their commits. Use list_repository-release for releases.
list_repository-tree: "List every file in coilyco/website recursively." "Find all go files in coilysiren/backend." "Show the git tree of main in coilyco/mobile." It returns the git tree for a branch or SHA, and recursive true lists every file path. Use get_repository-content to read a file once you have its path.
list_user-organization: 'What orgs does coilysiren belong to?' 'Which organizations is that user in?' 'List coilysiren's org memberships.' Returns organizations the named user belongs to. For the bot account's orgs use list_current-user-organization.
list_user-repository: 'What repos does coilysiren have?' 'Show me coilysiren's repos.' 'List all repos under that user account.' Returns repos owned by the named user. For org owned repos use list_organization-repository.
mcp_beaver_info: Report this MCP server's identity, mode, and served tool inventory. Read-only, reaches no upstream, and doubles as a liveness probe now that the protocol ping is gone.
merge_pull-request: "merge PR 2 in coilyco/api?" "squash merge PR 8 in coilysiren/site" "rebase PR 5 in coilyco/backend?" Merges the PR with your chosen merge style, optional merge title and message, and optional branch deletion after merge. See close_pull-request to close without merging.
reopen_pull-request: "reopen PR 2 in coilyco/api?" "reopen closed PR 9 in coilysiren/site" "reopen PR 14 in coilyco/backend?" Reopens a closed, unmerged PR. See close_pull-request to close it again without merging.
search_repository: 'Find repos named backend.' 'Does coilyco have a repo called server?' 'Search repos for backend with topic=true.' Returns repos matching the name and optional description, topic, or filter settings. It never searches file contents. For topic name search use search_topic.
search_topic: 'What topics match go?' 'Search topics named api.' 'How many repos use the topic kubernetes?' Returns matching topic names and the number of repos using each, not the repos themselves. For repos with a topic use search_repository.
